weaknesses.title: MULWHERE factor is integer only — no fractional scale
weaknesses.detail: Cannot ramp canary by 1.5x without two-step or non-integer path. BY 0 drains; negative factors may surprise.

weaknesses.title: COPYFWHERE/SWAPFWHERE equality match only — no weight>N cohort
weaknesses.detail: Selective snap/rollback needs a role/tag field; cannot match on weight threshold alone.
weaknesses.repro: want snap only weight>10 without role tag

weaknesses.title: Rollback without snap swaps zeros into weight
weaknesses.detail: SWAPFWHERE with prev=0 drains canary if snap skipped. No refuse-if-blank for numeric prev.

weaknesses.title: Empty SUMWHERE → 0; admit needs explicit N>0
weaknesses.detail: Ghost role sum 0 would admit under any budget without COUNTWHERE gate.
weaknesses.repro: admit missing budget 10 → deny only because N=0 gate

weaknesses.title: No atomic snap+scale single op
weaknesses.detail: Race window between COPYFWHERE and MULWHERE across multi-process ARG dispatch (plate rehydrate helps but two runs).
weaknesses.repro: snap then scale as separate CUBALC_ARG0 runs

weaknesses.title: Non-numeric REQUIRE/FACTOR softens
weaknesses.detail: REQUIRE=abc → soft; bad FACTOR keeps default.

workarounds: Always snap before scale for meaningful SWAPFWHERE rollback
Tag canary role for WHERE match; COUNTWHERE N>0 before admit
Integer factors only; multi-step for non-power-of-two ramps
Gate empty role via N>0 not sum alone
REQUIRE EXIT in action bodies; soft unknown wall
language_gaps: Empty SUMWHERE soft miss vs zero
SETMATCH ALL; WRITE trailing NL; strict NUM REQUIRE
